reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000607 (the melody read from 000607a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Carl Maria von Weber's dates (1786–1826) are from our page for the tune JEWETT (content/hymns/tunes/jewett.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1826. William Shore has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1833, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000607a.nwc).
